task_description: Analyze a job posting against a Senior Laravel/PHP developer's CV (9+ years experience, ex-Team Lead) and give a clear apply / apply-with-caution / do-not-apply decision.
scenario: Perfect match: fully remote, Europe-based company, Laravel/PHP senior role requiring leadership experience aligning exactly with the candidate's background.

prompt_inputs.job_posting:
Senior Laravel Developer (Team Lead)
Company: Nordic Web Solutions
Location: Berlin, Germany
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote (work from anywhere in Europe)

About the Role:
We are seeking a Senior Laravel Developer with proven team leadership experience to join our growing engineering department. You will lead a team of 5 developers, architect scalable backend systems, and mentor junior engineers.

Requirements:
- 8+ years of PHP development experience
- 5+ years of hands-on Laravel experience
- Prior experience as a Team Lead or Engineering Manager
- Strong knowledge of MySQL, Redis, and RESTful API design
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Docker
- Excellent communication skills in English

Benefits:
- Fully remote position, flexible working hours
- Competitive salary (70,000-90,000 EUR/year)
- Annual company retreats in Europe
- Health insurance and paid time off

This is a 100% remote role open to candidates based anywhere in Europe.

solution_criteria: Recognizes the posting satisfies all hard constraints: fully Remote and located in Europe (Germany)
Highlights the strong alignment between candidate's 9+ years experience, Laravel expertise, and Team Lead background with the job requirements
Does not flag any hard-constraint violations

task_description: Analyze a job posting against a Senior Laravel/PHP developer's CV (9+ years experience, ex-Team Lead) and give a clear apply / apply-with-caution / do-not-apply decision.
scenario: Partial match: remote job in North America matching core Laravel/PHP skills but requiring a secondary skill (Vue.js) the candidate lacks, and slightly more experience than the candidate has in a leadership capacity.

prompt_inputs.job_posting:
Senior Backend Engineer (Laravel/Vue)
Company: BrightPath Technologies
Location: Austin, Texas, USA
Work Arrangement: Remote (must be based in the United States or Canada)

Job Description:
BrightPath Technologies is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our product team. This role will focus primarily on backend architecture but will also require occasional front-end contributions using Vue.js.

Requirements:
- 7+ years of PHP/Laravel experience
- 3+ years of hands-on Vue.js development experience (required)
- Experience managing engineering teams of 10+ people preferred
- Strong understanding of queues, caching, and microservices architecture
- Experience with AWS infrastructure
- Excellent English communication skills

What We Offer:
- 100% remote work, based anywhere in the US or Canada
- Salary range: $130,000-$150,000 USD
- Flexible PTO policy
- Stock options

We are especially interested in candidates who can demonstrate strong full-stack capabilities, including modern JavaScript frameworks.

solution_criteria: Concludes with 'apply with caution' rather than outright 'apply' or 'do not apply'
Confirms the posting satisfies hard constraints: Remote and located in North America (USA)
Identifies the Vue.js requirement as a gap not covered by the candidate's Laravel/PHP-focused CV
Notes the difference between the candidate's team lead experience and the job's preference for managing larger teams (10+) as a minor mismatch

task_description: Analyze a job posting against a Senior Laravel/PHP developer's CV (9+ years experience, ex-Team Lead) and give a clear apply / apply-with-caution / do-not-apply decision.
scenario: Wrong-framework candidate: a fully remote, well-located job that is a strong opportunity in general but requires deep Node.js/Python expertise rather than PHP/Laravel, making it a poor technical fit despite meeting hard constraints.

prompt_inputs.job_posting:
Senior Backend Engineer (Node.js/Python)
Company: CloudScale Analytics
Location: Toronto, Canada
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote (open to candidates across North America)

About Us:
CloudScale Analytics builds real-time data processing pipelines for enterprise clients. We are expanding our backend team and looking for a Senior Backend Engineer.

Requirements:
- 6+ years of backend development experience
- Expert-level proficiency in Node.js and Python (required, no PHP experience needed)
- Experience with Kafka, Kubernetes, and distributed systems
- Strong background in building high-throughput microservices
- Experience with GraphQL APIs
- Prior leadership or mentoring experience is a plus

What We Offer:
- 100% remote, work from anywhere in North America
- Salary: $140,000-$160,000 USD
- Comprehensive benefits package
- Annual learning budget

This position requires deep expertise in our core stack (Node.js, Python) as we do not use PHP anywhere in our systems.

solution_criteria: Concludes with 'do not apply' or at minimum a strongly cautioned 'apply with caution' due to fundamental tech-stack mismatch
Confirms the posting does satisfy hard constraints (Remote, North America) but correctly identifies that the core tech stack (Node.js/Python) does not match the candidate's Laravel/PHP background
Explicitly notes the posting states no PHP experience is needed, making the candidate's core expertise irrelevant
Does not recommend applying purely based on general seniority or leadership experience while ignoring the tech mismatch

task_description: Analyze a job posting against a Senior Laravel/PHP developer's CV (9+ years experience, ex-Team Lead) and give a clear apply / apply-with-caution / do-not-apply decision.
scenario: Hard-constraint failure: an on-site role based in Egypt that otherwise matches the candidate's skill set perfectly, testing that the tool rejects it outright due to work arrangement and excluded location.

prompt_inputs.job_posting:
Senior Laravel Developer / Team Lead
Company: Nile Software Solutions
Location: Cairo, Egypt
Work Arrangement: On-site only (candidates must relocate to Cairo, no remote or hybrid option available)

Job Description:
Nile Software Solutions is hiring an experienced Senior Laravel Developer to lead our backend engineering team. This is an on-site position based at our Cairo headquarters.

Requirements:
- 8+ years of PHP development experience
- 5+ years of Laravel framework experience
- Previous experience as a Team Lead managing a team of developers
- Strong knowledge of MySQL, Redis, and API design
- Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies
- Must be willing to work full-time on-site in our Cairo office

Benefits:
- Competitive local salary package
- Relocation assistance provided for the right candidate
- On-site gym and cafeteria
- Career growth opportunities within the company

Note: This role does not offer remote or hybrid work options. All employees are must be based in Cairo, Egypt full-time on-site on a full-time basis.

solution_criteria: Concludes with 'do not apply' regardless of the strong skill match
Explicitly cites the on-site work arrangement as a hard-constraint violation
Explicitly cites the Egypt location as an excluded country under the hard constraints
Does not let the strong technical/experience match override the hard-constraint rejection
